A herniated disc is one of the most common sources of back pain. Timely and effective treatment can help significantly in pain reduction and arrest the condition from further deterioration. Dr Bhavin Shial is renowned spine surgeon in Mumbai and has a stellar success rate in treating patients with herniated disc or slipped disc. Let us be your partner in your journey from diagnosis to recovery. The first step in your journey is awareness; a patient with a ruptured disc or slipped disc may feel pain or tingling sensations in their neck, shoulders, back, arms, or legs. Normally these discs between each vertebra, provide cushioning to the joints. Sometimes, the disc becomes weak or damaged, cracking the annulus (outer layer of disc) causing a rupture. When the annulus is torn, then the nucleus populous (soft interior of disc) extrudes out, protruding through the exterior layer and extending outwards resulting in compression of the adjacent nerve roots and spinal cord within the spinal column, this is called a disc herniation or a slipped disc. Most of the time, disk herniation will improve with nonsurgical treatment. But a surgery is suggested by Dr Bhavin Shial when there are serious concerns like muscle weakness, mobility issues, persistent pain or loss of bladder and bowel control. There are multiple new age surgical procedures which are performed by Dr Bhavin depending upon your case which are assured to provide relief and regain normal mobility. Call now for appointments.

Spinal stenosis is a condition that leads to the narrowing of the spinal canal, which can compress the nerves and cause a variety of symptoms. Dr Bhavin Shial best spinal stenosis specialist in Mumbai explains that as we age, our bones and tissues begin to deteriorate. These changes can cause the ligaments in the spine to thicken and bone spurs to form, leading to the narrowing of the spinal canal which is stenosis. It is essential to understand the different types of spinal stenosis for accurate treatment. Depending upon the location of the stenosis in the spine and the body parts impacted, the stenosis is categorized as Cervical, Thoracic or Lumbar. Cervical Stenosis causes neck pain, numbness, and weakness in the shoulders, arms, and hands. While Lumbar Stenosis causes lower back pain, sciatica, and leg weakness, making it challenging to walk or stand for extended periods. Each type of spinal stenosis requires different management strategies to alleviate pain. With Dr Bhavin Shial, the first step of treatment is non-surgical to help manage pain and regain movement. Extremely Disappointed with the Doctor’s Approach

I recently visited this doctor for my mother’s severe spine and back issues, hoping for professional and thorough guidance. Unfortunately, our experience was far from satisfactory.

Before the visit, we had proactively conducted basic tests like CBC, ECG, and others to make the process smoother for the doctor. However, during the consultation, he simply glanced at her spine X-ray and suggested getting an MRI done under sedation (since she couldn’t lie down). When I informed him that we had already done tests like CBC, he barely looked at the reports and dismissed them with, “Whichever tests are done, you don’t need to do them again.” This left us questioning the point of getting these tests done if the doctor had no intention of reviewing them properly.

Things got worse when we went to get the MRI done. The anesthesiologist scolded us, asking why the doctor hadn’t checked my mother’s ECG. She has heart issues, which makes anesthesia dangerous due to the risk of BP drops — a potentially fatal situation. As a spine doctor, it was his responsibility to check critical reports like the ECG. That’s why we trust doctors — because as laypersons, we can’t read such reports ourselves!

When I called the doctor to inform him about this oversight, his response was shocking: *“I’m not a physician; I’m a spine doctor. It’s not my job to check that. You should have gone to a physician.”* This level of negligence and passing the buck is unacceptable. Even a general MD doctor can interpret an ECG, and ignoring it could have risked my mother’s life.

Overall, the experience left us feeling frustrated and disappointed. The doctor came across as all talk and no action, showing little regard for patient safety or thoroughness. I wouldn’t recommend him to anyone looking for competent and reliable care.

What stood out the most was his availability and involvement even after surgery. He was accessible on WhatsApp for both small and big questions and guided me step by step through recovery, which gave immense confidence during a very anxious phase.

The surgery went smoothly, recovery has been steady.

Dr. Pawar is highly skilled, practical, and genuinely focused on patient outcomes. I felt safe and well supported throughout the journey.

There is no word that can truly capture the depth of our gratitude towards Dr. Abhijit Pawar and his team for the remarkable care they provided during my father’s treatment in Kokilaben Dhirubhai Ambani hospital.

From the very first consultation, it was clear that Dr. Pawar was very compassionate, treating my father with dignity, respect, and a level of personalized attention that immediately set him apart. Those 10 hours during surgery felt like a lifetime! We found ourselves trapped between hope n fear.. It was the most terrifying and hardest time in our life, a moment when the world felt painfully out of control. But in that darkness, we had full faith and confidence in him. Not only was the surgery successful, but my father has also experienced a remarkable recovery. On 31st Dec, post op day3 we got discharged with smiles. We will forever be grateful for their role in not just saving, but improving my father’s life.We are truly blessed to have had him as my father’s surgeon, and I cannot recommend them highly enough. Also we cannot thank you enough Dr Hari for your excellent care🙏. Thank you for this wonderful new year gift Dr Abhijit Pawar sir. May new year bring you endless joy, health and success ..

featured_reviews.name: shaheena bano
featured_reviews.review_text:
My father (66) underwent spine surgery (L3/L4, L4/L5) under Dr. Abhijit Pawar. Before surgery, he had numbness in one leg, but despite repeated assurances that the surgery was low‑risk and a ‘game changer,’ the outcome was devastating. Post‑surgery, he suffered severe persistent pain at the surgical site for over a year, worsening numbness in both legs, loss of mobility, and dependency for basic activities, including inability to use the toilet independently for months.

For over a year, we remained in constant contact with Dr. Pawar, who repeatedly reassured us that things would improve with time.
A serious spinal infection and implant issues were missed and not acknowledged, and only a second corrective surgery at another hospital resolved the problem almost immediately.

This experience raises serious concerns about surgical judgment, post‑operative care, and follow‑up by Dr. Abhijit Pawar. I strongly advise patients to seek multiple independent opinions before proceeding with spine surgery under him.”

If you want to save your parents, your money and your family’s peace avoid this doctor

I am responding only to correct factual inaccuracies in the doctor’s reply.

My father does not have diabetes or any other medical conditions. This is documented in his pre-operative evaluations and hospital records.
